rule: Hand decisions over the automatic picker, each with its reason. banner = use the Wikivoyage banner; main = use the Wikidata main image; none = show no photo.

kp.why: Banner shows soldiers marching at a martyrs' cemetery; peace-first guardrail.

mm.why: Main image is a close portrait of identifiable monks.

ps.why: Main image is the separation wall at a checkpoint; a neutral landscape suits a planning page.

ro.why: Main image is a pile of postage stamps, not the place.

sa.why: Banner is the Kaaba in Mecca, which non-Muslim visitors cannot enter.

pg.why: Banner shows identifiable people in ceremonial dress; avoid costume imagery as a national symbol.

st.why: Banner is a photo of bird eggs.

us/north-carolina.why: Banner is a plate of barbecue.

us/new-jersey.why: Banner is a neon slogan sign.

us/minnesota.why: Main image is a roadside welcome sign.

cn/tibet.why: Main image is a space-station view captioned as China, not specifically Tibet.

au/nt.why: Banner shows rock art at Uluru; Anangu ask that sacred sites and rock art not be photographed or used. Main image is a bushfire satellite view.
